day_local: UMsitho kaSanti Mateyu, uMpostile kunye noMvangeli
greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: Amazwi abo avakala kuwo wonke umhlaba.
homily:
Kukho umfanekiso ohlala unamathele engqondweni yam xa ndicinga ngoBenjamin Vo. Hayi indiza enkulu esibhakabhakeni, hayi ikhompyutha ayeyikodileyo, kodwa umzuzu othi cwaka ekhitshini. Khumbula uBen ehlezi phantsi, enxibe iibhulukhwe zakhe eziluhlaza, ephethe isilawuli somdlalo, amehlo akhe ecinga nzulu ngento ethile ebalulekileyo. Kwakukho ukuzola okumangalisayo kulo mfana. Wayengumfana owayebona ihlabathi ngenjongo, owayefuna ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani—ukusuka kwizindiza ezinkulu ukuya kwindlela yokwakha 'con chim airlines' yakhe—kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayeyindoda encane eyayiqonda ukuba uthando luyinto yokwenziwa, hayi yokuthethwa nje.

Namhlanje, kwiVangeli, uYesu uhamba ngendlela yakhe, waza wabona uMateyu ehlezi kwindawo yokuqokelela irhafu. UYesu akazange ajonge izono zikaMateyu, akazange ajonge indawo awayekuyo, okanye indlela abanye ababembona ngayo. UYesu wathi kuye, 'Landela mna.' Kwaye uMateyu waphakama. Washiya yonke into. Washiya itafile yakhe, irhafu yakhe, kunye nendlela yakhe yakudala yokuphila, ukuze alandele uYesu.

Nangona kunjalo, masime apha. Masithethe inyaniso. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Iinyanga ezintathu zokuziva ukuba indlu ithule kakhulu. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba usizi luyinto enzima, ngakumbi xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana wakho owayekuthanda kakhulu, owayekulalele xa ubalisa amabali akho, owayekuthanda kakhulu njengoba wayekuthanda ukuhamba nawe, Ryan. Usizi aluhambi ngokwekhalenda. Niyazibuza ukuba kwenzeke ntoni. Niyazibuza ukuba kutheni lo mfana owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele, kufuneka ahambe ngolu hlobo. Niyazibuza ukuba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndicela niphulaphule: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto eniyenze ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. UThixo akathumeli ukugula. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo, kwaye uBen ukhululekile kuyo yonke intlungu.

KwiVangeli, abafarisi bayabuza, 'Kutheni utitshala wenu edla nabathelisi naboni?' UYesu uphendula ngamazwi amandla: 'Abo baphilileyo abayidingi ingcali yezonyango, kodwa abagulayo bayayidinga. Hamba ufunde intsingiselo yamazwi athi, 'Ndifuna inceba, hayi idini.' UYesu uza kuthatha abantu apo bakhoyo. Uza kuthatha uMateyu, umoni, amenze umpostile. Uza kuthatha uBen, amthabathe amse kwiBanquet yasezulwini apho akukho zigulo, akukho ntlungu, kwaye akukho zinyembezi.

Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu. UBen wayeyindoda encane eyayiqonda ukuba uthando luyinto yokwenziwa. Khumbula ukuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu. Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo.

Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wam, ndikholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ulapha, kwaye ndizidibanisa ngokupheleleyo nawe. Ungandivumeli ndahlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisikelele kwaye isigcine, isikhulule kuyo yonke intlungu, kwaye isikhokelele kuxolo lwayo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela umphefumlo kaBenjamin Vo kunye nabo bonke abaswelekileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasebumnyameni bosizi, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele, abanike ithemba, kwaye abomeleze kule mihla.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bafowethu noodadewethu: Mna, ndisiboshwa seNkosi, ndiyanicela ukuba niphile ngendlela efanelekileyo kubizo enilufumeneyo, ngokuthobeka nangeemfesane zonke, nangonyamezelo, ninyamezelana ngothando, nizama ukugcina umanyano loMoya ngesibopho soxolo: umzimba mnye noMoya mnye, njengoko nabizwa nani kwithemba elinye lobizo lwenu; iNkosi inye, ukholo lunye, ubhaptizo lunye; uThixo emnye noYise wabo bonke, ophezu kwabo bonke, nophakathi kwabo bonke, nakuwo wonke umntu. Kodwa ubabalo lwanikwa elowo kuthi ngokomlinganiselo wesipho sikaKristu. Kwaye wanika abanye ukuba babe ngabaphostile, abanye babe ngabaprofeti, abanye babe ngabavangeli, abanye babe ngabalusi nabafundisi, ukulungiselela abangcwele umsebenzi wenkonzo, ukwakha umzimba kaKristu, de sonke sifikelele kumanyano lokholo nolwazi loNyana kaThixo, kumntu ogqibeleleyo, kumlinganiselo wobukhulu obupheleleyo bukaKristu.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Amazwi abo avakala kuwo wonke umhlaba. Izulu libhengeza uzuko lukaThixo; nesibhakabhaka sibhengeza umsebenzi wezandla zakhe. Imini iphalaza ilizwi emini, nobusuku bubhengeza ulwazi ebusuku. R. Amazwi abo avakala kuwo wonke umhlaba. Akukho lizwi nakusithetha apho ilizwi lingaviwayo khona; kuwo wonke umhlaba ilizwi labo livakala, nakwimiphelo yehlabathi, umyalezo wabo. R. Amazwi abo avakala kuwo wonke umhlaba.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Njengoko uYesu wayedlula, wabona indoda egama linguMateyu ihlezi kwindawo yokuqokelela irhafu. Wathi kuye, 'Landela mna.' Waphakama walandela yena. Ngoxa wayesetafileni endlwini yakhe, abathelisi abaninzi naboni beza, bahlala noYesu nabafundi bakhe. AbaFarisi bakubona oku, bathi kubafundi bakhe, 'Kutheni utitshala wenu edla nabathelisi naboni?' Weva oku, wathi, 'Abo baphilileyo abayidingi ingcali yezonyango, kodwa abagulayo bayayidinga. Hamba ufunde intsingiselo yamazwi athi, Ndifuna inceba, hayi idini. Andizanga kubiza abalungileyo, ndize kubiza aboni.'

day: Feast of Saint Matthew, Apostle and evangelist

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
